#!/bin/bash
# Training iterations of the C++ search at 256x8 on the GPU with more concurrent games:
# 7 game processes of N games each, the matched runs' command otherwise.
set -u
OUT=OUT
CODE=OUT2/new
for per in "$@"; do
  games=$((7 * per))
  name="games-$games"
  cd "$CODE" || exit 1
  env -u MallocNanoZone .venv/bin/python tools/supervise_campaign_training.py --profile mac \
    --control-dir "$OUT/$name-control" --run-dir "$OUT/$name" --seconds 5400 --max-restarts 0 -- \
    --calendar-rounds 11 --complete-episodes --batches 1 --transitions-per-batch 20000 --simulations 64 \
    --max-depth 16 --hidden-dim 256 --message-layers 8 --batch-size 32 --epochs 525 --replay-capacity 8000 \
    --sample-fraction 0.05 --seed 20261119 --neural-device mps --no-continuous --compiled-forward \
    --episode-workers 7 --games-per-process "$per" --parallel-envs "$games" > "$OUT/$name.log" 2>&1 &
  supervisor=$!
  REPO/.venv/bin/python tools/log_process_load.py record --pid "$supervisor" \
    --output "$OUT/$name-load.jsonl" > "$OUT/$name-load.log" 2>&1 &
  logger=$!
  echo "$(date '+%F %T') started $name supervisor $supervisor" >> "$OUT/driver.log"
  wait "$supervisor"
  wait "$logger"
  echo "$(date '+%F %T') finished $name" >> "$OUT/driver.log"
done
echo "$(date '+%F %T') all done" >> "$OUT/driver.log"

#!/bin/bash
# The 378-game layout again, on an otherwise idle Mac, with a memory watchdog.
set -u
OUT=OUT
CODE=OUT2/new
name=games-378-rerun
cd "$CODE" || exit 1
env -u MallocNanoZone .venv/bin/python tools/supervise_campaign_training.py --profile mac \
  --control-dir "$OUT/$name-control" --run-dir "$OUT/$name" --seconds 5400 --max-restarts 0 -- \
  --calendar-rounds 11 --complete-episodes --batches 1 --transitions-per-batch 20000 --simulations 64 \
  --max-depth 16 --hidden-dim 256 --message-layers 8 --batch-size 32 --epochs 525 --replay-capacity 8000 \
  --sample-fraction 0.05 --seed 20261119 --neural-device mps --no-continuous --compiled-forward \
  --episode-workers 7 --games-per-process 54 --parallel-envs 378 > "$OUT/$name.log" 2>&1 &
supervisor=$!
REPO/.venv/bin/python tools/log_process_load.py record --pid "$supervisor" \
  --output "$OUT/$name-load.jsonl" > "$OUT/$name-load.log" 2>&1 &
logger=$!
echo "$(date '+%F %T') started $name supervisor $supervisor" >> "$OUT/driver.log"
# Watchdog: critical memory pressure, swap grown by 4 GB, or the kernel's share of
# the CPU above 35% in three checks running (about 30 s).
swap0=$(sysctl -n vm.swapusage | sed -E 's/.*used = ([0-9.]+)M.*/\1/')
hot=0
while kill -0 "$supervisor" 2>/dev/null; do
  level=$(sysctl -n kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level)
  swap=$(sysctl -n vm.swapusage | sed -E 's/.*used = ([0-9.]+)M.*/\1/')
  kernel=$(top -l 2 -n 0 -s 1 | grep "CPU usage" | tail -1 | sed -E 's/.* ([0-9.]+)% sys.*/\1/')
  kernel=${kernel:-0}
  grown=$(echo "$swap - $swap0" | bc)
  if [ "${kernel%.*}" -gt 35 ]; then hot=$((hot + 1)); else hot=0; fi
  echo "$(date '+%T') pressure $level swap ${swap}M grown ${grown}M kernel ${kernel}%" >> "$OUT/$name-watchdog.log"
  if [ "$level" -ge 4 ] || [ "${grown%.*}" -gt 4096 ] || [ "$hot" -ge 3 ]; then
    echo "$(date '+%F %T') watchdog stopped $name: pressure $level, swap grown ${grown}M, kernel ${kernel}%" >> "$OUT/driver.log"
    kill -TERM "$supervisor"
    break
  fi
  sleep 9
done
wait "$supervisor"
wait "$logger"
echo "$(date '+%F %T') finished $name" >> "$OUT/driver.log"

"""The concurrent-games runs' numbers, with the 126-game runs of the matched pairs."""
import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

TOOL = "REPO/tools/log_process_load.py"
PY = "REPO/.venv/bin/python"
DIRS = {"new-1": "OUT2",
        "new-2": "OUT2"}
DEFAULT = "OUT"


def run(name):
    out = Path(DIRS.get(name, DEFAULT))
    manifest = json.loads((out / name / "manifest.json").read_text())
    state = json.loads((out / f"{name}-control" / "state.json").read_text())
    counters, playing = manifest["counters"], manifest["timings_seconds_this_invocation"]["collection"]
    evaluator = manifest["runner"]["updates"][0]["evaluator"]
    lines = (out / name / "progress.jsonl").read_text().strip().splitlines()
    episodes = json.loads(lines[0])["episodes"]
    rates = [sum(e["decisions_by_actor"].values()) / e["worker_seconds"] * 3600 for e in episodes]
    load = json.loads(subprocess.run([PY, TOOL, "summarize", str(out / f"{name}-load.jsonl")],
                                     capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout)
    load.pop("windows", None)
    games = load["processes"]["game processes"]
    server = load["processes"]["coordinator"]
    return {
        "run": name, "concurrent_games": counters["episodes"], "status": manifest["status"],
        "terminal_games": sum(1 for e in episodes if e.get("terminal")), "decisions": counters["decisions"],
        "playing_seconds": round(playing, 1),
        "decisions_per_hour_while_playing": round(counters["decisions"] / playing * 3600),
        "decisions_per_hour_while_all_games_played": round(sum(rates)),
        "network_evaluations_per_second": round(evaluator["evaluations"] / playing, 1),
        "mean_inference_batch_states": round(evaluator["evaluations"] / evaluator["serving_rounds"], 2),
        "inference_server_waiting_share": round(evaluator["idle_seconds"] / playing, 4),
        "inference_server_answering_us_per_evaluation": round(evaluator["forward_seconds"] / evaluator["evaluations"] * 1e6, 1),
        "batch_cpu_cores": load["batch_cores"], "other_work_cpu_cores": load["other_work_cores"],
        "seconds_with_game_processes": load["seconds_with_game_processes"],
        "game_processes_cpu_ms_per_network_evaluation": round(games["cpu_seconds"] / evaluator["evaluations"] * 1e3, 3),
        "game_processes_cpu_cores_mean": round(games["cpu_seconds"] / load["seconds_with_game_processes"], 2),
        "game_processes_performance_core_share": games["performance_core_share"],
        "game_processes_waiting_for_a_core_per_cpu_second": games["waiting_per_cpu_second"],
        "inference_server_cpu_cores_mean": round(server["cpu_seconds"] / load["seconds_with_game_processes"], 3),
        "peak_rss_bytes_sampled": state["aggregate_sampled_peak_rss_bytes"],
        "load_summary": load,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    runs = [run(name) for name in sys.argv[1:]]
    if "--json" in sys.argv[0:1]:
        pass
    for r in runs:
        brief = {k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "load_summary"}
        print(json.dumps(brief))


def detail(name):
    """The earlier record's second table, and serving time by inference batch size."""
    out = Path(DIRS.get(name, DEFAULT))
    manifest = json.loads((out / name / "manifest.json").read_text())
    counters, timings = manifest["counters"], manifest["timings_seconds_this_invocation"]
    evaluator = manifest["runner"]["updates"][0]["evaluator"]
    episodes = json.loads((out / name / "progress.jsonl").read_text().strip().splitlines()[0])["episodes"]
    ends = sorted(e["worker_seconds"] for e in episodes)
    sizes = {int(size): (count, seconds) for size, (count, seconds) in evaluator["inference_batches"].items()}
    states, half, median = sum(size * count for size, (count, _) in sizes.items()), 0, None
    for size in sorted(sizes):
        half += size * sizes[size][0]
        if median is None and half * 2 >= states:
            median = size
    playing = timings["collection"]
    serving = {size: round(seconds / count * 1e6) for size, (count, seconds) in sorted(sizes.items()) if count >= 200}
    return {
        "run": name, "games": counters["episodes"], "decisions": counters["decisions"],
        "decisions_per_game": round(counters["decisions"] / counters["episodes"]),
        "network_evaluations_per_decision": round(evaluator["evaluations"] / counters["decisions"], 1),
        "playing_seconds": round(playing), "first_game_ended": round(ends[0]), "last_game_ended": round(ends[-1]),
        "network_update_seconds": round(timings["learning_updates"], 1), "inference_batches": evaluator["serving_rounds"],
        "median_state_inference_batch": median, "answering_seconds": round(evaluator["forward_seconds"]),
        "reading_and_replying_seconds": round(playing - evaluator["forward_seconds"] - evaluator["idle_seconds"]),
        "waiting_seconds": round(evaluator["idle_seconds"]),
        "serving_us_by_inference_batch_size": serving,
    }
